question: How many group's curves ever drop below 0 when G=4?

steps.description: Locate the chart titled 'G = 4 Time Profiles' in the image
Count the number of curves displayed in the chart
Examine each curve to determine if it crosses below the horizontal zero line
Check the black curve (Group 1) to see if it goes below the zero line
Check the red curve (Group 2) to see if it goes below the zero line
Check the teal curve (Group 3) to see if it goes below the zero line
Check the purple curve (Group 4) to see if it goes below the zero line
Count how many curves were found to drop below zero in previous steps
Conclude the final count of groups whose curves drop below zero
